subject: An apparent missing or anomalous episode is a question for corroboration rather than an established fact; a mismatch suggesting an omission calls for clarification through an already agreed follow-up.
rationale: Alignment can expose inconsistencies, but ambiguous or false alignments can also arise from disturbances, measurement error or insufficient overlap. A mismatch therefore warrants corroboration without establishing an omitted episode. The target permits voluntary follow-up and prohibits unsolicited repeated contact, supporting clarification through already agreed contact. This limitation asserts neither an actual omission nor successful corroboration.
